counterfactual_missing_items: lack of obstructive coronary artery disease
decisive_items: repetitive monomorphic premature ventricular complexes with atypical left bundle-branch block/left axis deviation–like morphology and short-coupling interval of 240 milliseconds
recurrent episodes of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, some deteriorating into ventricular fibrillation
variant of unknown significance in the coding gene of cardiac ryanodine receptor (RyR2)
response.rationale: R3 is the strongest candidate due to its comprehensive support from ECG findings, genetic testing, and the presence of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, which are all consistent with Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia (CPVT). C1 is a close runner-up, but its association with the RyR2 variant is not as strongly supported as R3's overall clinical presentation.

rejected.why: normal echocardiography results contradict the diagnosis of Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy (ARVC)
